source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #294 (branch fix/292-optimizer-miri-uninit at head 46931a9d03bccc58b8135269aaa612fd01d639c3 — branch commit fe8e601 (fully initialize narrow operands so raw lowering reads no uninitialized bytes (#292)) and merge commit 46931a9 bringing in current main 3922f93 (PR #293, #191; which itself includes PR #291 and PR #290); ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45334558431 and 45334660340 against the branch and pull-request run 45334543654, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #294 (#292, Miri-found uninitialized read in the optimizer pipeline). The fix adds canonical constructors on the Operand union (from_i32/from_u32/from_f32/from_jump_addr/from_drop_size/from_local_addr/from_select, each zeroing the high four bytes of the raw encoding) and replaces 78 narrow union literals across the parser and the pipeline raw_* helpers with them, so the raw eight-byte lowering in lower_operand never reads uninitialized bytes. Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone (workflow_dispatch run 45334673188, gate success): it reproduces the pre-#292 baseline exactly on all 32 gated series, so every delta below is this PR's own. Against main, 28 of the 32 gated series change; the baseline configuration is unchanged. In release every changed series grows by exactly its stripped .text delta (pure code growth, no data change): core, core-aot and core-jit each grow by 448 B stripped file / 448 B stripped .text, component and wasi by 208 B / 208 B, wasi-threads by 224 B / 224 B, and core-nosimd by 144 B / 144 B. In release-size the deltas are small and mixed: component grows by 96 B / 96 B, wasi by 96 B / 96 B, wasi-threads by 64 B / 64 B, core shrinks by 48 B / 16 B, core-jit by 48 B / 32 B, core-nosimd by 48 B / 32 B, and core-aot by 32 B / 16 B. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is the release component stripped file series at +9.60% (2,433,656 B to 2,667,344 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison. Run-to-run spread was again 0 B for every gated series across the three samples.
